line.en: Imp's job is teaching: he demonstrates how five peas take down a zombie, with impeccable form and perfect attendance.
line.zh: 小鬼的主要工作是教学：示范怎么被五发豌豆打倒，动作标准，从不请假。

line.en: Super-Fan Imp spent all of his stamina on cheering. What is left is enough for five peas and nothing more.
line.zh: 狂热粉丝小鬼把全部体力都花在应援上了，剩下的部分只够撑五发豌豆。

line.en: Soccer Imp wears the full kit. The shin guards are cardboard. He is substituted before the whistle.
line.zh: 足球小鬼一身队服，护腿板是纸做的——裁判还没吹哨，他就已经下场了。

line.en: Imp Mummy is wrapped in three thousand years of bandages. They are excellent against damp and useless against peas.
line.zh: 木乃伊小鬼裹了三千年的绷带，防潮，不防豌豆，一撕就开。

line.en: Imp Pirate Zombie believes his eyepatch will stop a bullet. It has been proven to stop sunlight.
line.zh: 海盗小鬼相信木板眼罩能挡子弹，事实证明它只挡得住阳光。

line.en: Bug Bot Imp's plating is a demo build. The lower half shipped; the upper half is still crowdfunding.
line.zh: 机械虫小鬼的装甲是演示版，只装了下半身，上半身还在众筹。

line.en: Imp Dragon Zombie's fire is real. His body is paper. He catches himself faster than he catches plants.
line.zh: 火龙小鬼的火是真的，身子是纸糊的，点着自己比点着植物还快。

line.en: Imp Monk Zombie keeps a vow against killing. The plants keep a simpler vow: five peas.
line.zh: 僧侣小鬼守戒不杀生，植物守着一个更简单的戒：五发豌豆。

line.en: Imp Mermaid Zombie is out of water and dragging a tail. Two steps and he is winded; five peas settle it.
line.zh: 美人鱼小鬼离了水，尾巴拖在地上，走两步就喘，五发豌豆足够。

line.en: Yeti Imp is a legend in the snow and merely a snowman on a lawn. He shrugs off freezing. He does not shrug off five peas.
line.zh: 雪人小鬼在雪里是神话，在草坪上只是个雪人；他连冰冻都不怕，却挡不住五发豌豆。

line.en: Imp Porter Zombie carries the entire tent. The tent outweighs him, which is why he no longer bothers dodging.
line.zh: 搬运工小鬼背着整座帐篷，帐篷比他还沉，压得他懒得躲。

line.en: Lost City Imp Zombie grew used to an undisturbed ruin. One pea is enough to reintroduce him to the world.
line.zh: 失落之城小鬼习惯了没人打扰的废墟，一株豌豆就够他重新认识世界。

line.en: Rocket Imp's thruster works once. The landing hurts more than the plants do.
line.zh: 火箭小鬼的推进器只够飞一次，落地那一下比植物打的还疼。

line.en: Kongfu Monk Imp trained ten years in iron qigong. The one technique his master skipped was blocking peas.
line.zh: 武僧小鬼练了十年硬气功，师父唯一没教的是怎么挡豌豆。

line.en: Abbot Imp handles the chanting. The sutra is long, and it ends at exactly the fifth pea.
line.zh: 住持小鬼负责念经，经文很长，念到第五发豌豆的时候正好念完。

line.en: Impunk's spikes are glued on. He turns the volume all the way up; his body did not come along.
line.zh: 朋克小鬼的钉子全是粘上去的，音量开到最大，身体没跟上。

line.en: Jurassic Imp is wearing borrowed hide. The original owner could take far more punishment.
line.zh: 侏罗纪小鬼身上那层皮是借来的，原主人比它耐揍得多。

line.en: Imp Paratrooper falls over on every landing. After that, the plants rarely need to help.
line.zh: 伞兵小鬼每次着陆都摔一跤，摔完这一下，基本不用植物再动手。

title.en: The First Man to Aim Upward
The Blue Sky Is Dead, the Yellow Sky Rises
